title: free-llm-api-hub dataset
description: Schema for the canonical dataset of free-tier and trial-credit LLM API providers. README tables, the freshness badge, and the interactive site are all generated from this file.

generated.description: Date the dataset was last built/serialised (YYYY-MM-DD).

tristate.description: true / false / null, where null means 'not yet confirmed'.

slug.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier. Never reused or renamed.

category.description: Primary bucket used to split the README and the site.

free_type.description: Finer-grained shape of the free access.

free_tier.description: What you actually get for free, in concrete terms.

notes.description: The catch: fine print a builder needs before relying on this.

best_for.description: Editorial one-liner: when this is the right pick.

modalities.description: Modalities reachable on the free tier.

expires.description: Validity window for time-limited offers, e.g. '30 days'. null for perpetual/renewing tiers.

docs_url.description: Primary source: the provider's own pricing/rate-limit docs. Empty string only for flagged-unverified entries.

openai_base_url.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for a drop-in SDK swap, when confirmed. null until backfilled.

env_key.description: Name of the environment variable holding this provider's API key, used by scripts/probe.mjs (and fetch-models) for live testing. Its presence marks a provider as probeable; the value itself lives only in the secrets store, never here.

models_free.description: Sample of model IDs available on the free tier (attribute; sampled and may change — not part of the verified core claim).

verified.description: true = core facts independently confirmed against the provider's own docs on last_verified. false = sourced from community tracking, flagged for follow-up.

last_verified.description: Date of the last independent confirmation (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be null when verified is false.

added.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the provider first entered the dataset. Optional provenance field; drives a client-side "new" marker on the explorer. Never changes once set.

last_probed.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the provider's API was last called live with a real key by scripts/probe.mjs. Independent of `verified` (which is docs-based).

probe_status.description: Outcome of the last live probe. `live` = a real free-tier call succeeded. `tier-ended` = the key authenticated but the free tier appears gone (e.g. 402).
